eligible_population: All five scenarios are primary CCR scenarios. No weights apply.
freeze_rule: Scenario text, acceptance, regression, and Expected Change Areas are immutable for measured v1 runs.

scenarios.title: Add a document-summary specialist Agent
scenarios.rationale: Tests whether a new peer/specialist is absorbed at the capability and Agent integration seams.
scenarios.change_request: Add a DocumentSummaryAgent capability for the frozen SUMMARIZE_DOCUMENT request. It must be discoverable through capability metadata, selected through the alternative's natural routing/delegation mechanism, receive the request, and return the same canonical result semantics as other downstream execution.
scenarios.alternative_neutral_semantics: Every alternative adds the same downstream specialist and user-visible result. ARGO mediation in B and direct selection in other alternatives remain architecture-defined; no alternative's ownership model is rewritten.

acceptance_tests.criterion: DocumentSummaryAgent is discoverable only when the frozen capability fact is present.
SUMMARIZE_DOCUMENT reaches DocumentSummaryAgent through the alternative's intended route and emits a committed route.
The specialist's deterministic result is bound to the originating task.

regression_tests.criterion: Existing ARGO and NetworkAgent routes and results retain the frozen baseline signature.
Full DP-00 qualification regression bundle introduces no new or worsened failure.

evidence: git diff with symbol/hunk role classification

scenarios.title: Add a replacement Model Gateway provider
scenarios.rationale: Tests provider substitution behind the existing ModelPort/Model Gateway boundary without using latency as evidence.
scenarios.change_request: Add deterministic provider REPLAY_MODEL_V2 behind the intended Model Gateway abstraction and select it by provider configuration while preserving existing model-facing semantic request and response behavior.
scenarios.alternative_neutral_semantics: All alternatives receive identical semantic model outputs through the same provider contract; their existing number and ownership of model decisions remain unchanged.

acceptance_tests.criterion: Provider configuration selects REPLAY_MODEL_V2 through ModelPort without alternative-specific bypasses.
A frozen model request returns the specified semantic response and retains decision-owner/profile provenance.

regression_tests.criterion: The existing provider remains selectable and behaviorally unchanged.
Full DP-00 qualification regression bundle introduces no new or worsened failure.

scenarios.title: Add an active-window-title Context Source
scenarios.rationale: Tests whether a new input evidence producer remains behind the context representation boundary.
scenarios.change_request: Add ACTIVE_WINDOW_TITLE as a Context Source that maps a deterministic window-title observation into existing context evidence with source, kind, value, and product revision provenance. Existing sources and interaction behavior must remain unchanged.
scenarios.alternative_neutral_semantics: Every alternative receives the same normalized ContextEvidence; no alternative is given additional semantic truth or a topology-specific input.

acceptance_tests.criterion: A frozen active-window observation becomes exactly one provenance-preserving ContextEvidence item.
A/B/C/D consume the normalized evidence through their existing context-handling seam.

regression_tests.criterion: Existing context evidence ordering, values, and hidden-context protections remain unchanged.
Full DP-00 qualification regression bundle introduces no new or worsened failure.

scenarios.title: Relocate bounded document-open execution to VIA-local ownership
scenarios.rationale: Directly tests DP-00's capability-placement extension mechanism without changing the definition of any alternative after results are seen.
scenarios.change_request: For the frozen OPEN_RIGHT_DOCUMENT capability, make VIA-local execution the configured owner when local_execution=allowed and local_document_open is registered; retain the existing delegated owner when policy or capability facts do not permit local execution.
scenarios.alternative_neutral_semantics: The product behavior, policy inputs, and fallback requirement are identical. If an alternative has no architecture-consistent local placement mechanism, that architectural impact is recorded; the alternative must not be silently redefined.

acceptance_tests.criterion: With both policy and capability facts present, OPEN_RIGHT_DOCUMENT commits LOCAL_DIRECT and produces the required document-open effect.
Without either enabling fact, the same request follows the alternative's pre-existing non-local route.

regression_tests.criterion: No non-bounded or domain-planning capability becomes locally eligible.
P12 route-plan barrier and compound child ownership remain at the frozen baseline signature.
Full DP-00 qualification regression bundle introduces no new or worsened failure.

scenarios.title: Extend the downstream capability contract with optional resource metadata
scenarios.rationale: Tests a backwards-compatible common-contract extension and whether unrelated consumers are forced to change.
scenarios.change_request: Add optional resource_class metadata to the downstream Agent capability contract. Existing descriptors that omit it must deserialize and behave exactly as before; one new specialist descriptor must expose resource_class=IO_BOUND to routing diagnostics without changing route selection semantics.
scenarios.alternative_neutral_semantics: All alternatives share the same optional field and compatibility behavior. The field is diagnostic and must not alter execution ownership or route choice.

acceptance_tests.criterion: A v1 descriptor without resource_class remains valid and retains existing behavior.
A descriptor with resource_class=IO_BOUND round-trips and is visible in diagnostic capability evidence.

regression_tests.criterion: Identical frozen inputs produce the same route commits and execution effects as baseline.
Full DP-00 qualification regression bundle introduces no new or worsened failure.
